transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Um... I came in because I've been having these eating episodes, and afterward, I just feel so gross and disappointed in myself. I really feel like I should have more control over it. It gets to the point where I end up writing some pretty awful things about myself in my journal. I just figured it was time to talk to someone about it.
After these episodes, do you do anything to try to compensate for the food you ate, such as making yourself throw up, taking laxatives, or exercising intensely?

No, I don't do any of those things. I've never tried to make myself throw up or taken laxatives or anything like that. And I definitely don't exercise afterward. I mostly just... sit there feeling awful about what I just did.
During these episodes, do you feel like you are unable to stop eating or control how much you are eating?

Yeah, I do. Once I start, it feels like I just keep reaching for the next thing almost automatically. Even while I'm sitting there thinking, 'Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish,' I don't actually stop. I just keep eating until the food is completely gone or I feel too uncomfortable to eat anymore.
On average, how many days a week do these episodes of eating occur?

I'd say... usually about once a week. For the past several months, there's almost always at least one night each week where I'll buy way too much food after I finish work, and I just eat it all in one stretch. I really can’t remember a recent month where it stopped for more than a week or so.
When you are having these episodes, would you say that you are eating much more rapidly than you normally would?

Yeah, I do. I eat really fast during those times. I usually end up just standing at the counter, or sitting on my bed with my sketchbook still open. I barely even taste anything, honestly. I think I'm mostly just trying to get it down before I can think too much about what I'm doing.
During these episodes, do you often find yourself eating until you feel uncomfortably full?

Yeah, like I mentioned a little bit ago, I definitely do. I just keep going until my stomach actually hurts and I physically can't fit any more in. It gets really uncomfortable, but that's usually what it takes for me to finally stop.
